existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 keeps the `SearchParameter` artifact identity but introduces several local hard validation breaks. Top concerns are loss of XPath fields, mandatory `processingMode` for expressions, changed required code domains, and resource-type binding differences; the main uncertainty is exact terminology-expansion behavior for version-independent resource types.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should treat SearchParameter definitions as executable conformance metadata, not passive documentation. Bulk transforms need to remove XPath fields, populate `processingMode`, rename `ofType` to `of-type`, validate `base`/`target` resource codes, update generated enum sets, and preserve R6-only metadata through extensions when downgrading to R4.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for local element, cardinality, type, constraint, and binding deltas because both StructureDefinitions and local CodeSystems were available. Confidence is medium for exact resource-type binding impact because no external terminology expansion service or official cross-version ConceptMap was used.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
SearchParameter keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 6 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 2 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 81/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: SearchParameter.xpath and SearchParameter.xpathUsage were removed in R6
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances containing `xpath` or `xpathUsage` use element names absent from the R6 base resource; generated models and validators may reject them, and R6-to-R4 conversion cannot recover an XPath from `processingMode` alone.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: SearchParameter.base and target changed to a version-independent resource-type binding that is not a simple R4 superset
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 SearchParameters whose `base` or `target` names an absent R4 resource code can fail R6 required-binding validation, affecting capability discovery and generated enums.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Search modifier code ofType was renamed to of-type and new modifier codes were added
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 metadata listing `ofType` fails the R6 required binding, and clients or servers comparing generated modifier enums or URL modifiers must handle a renamed code.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 requires processingMode whenever expression is present
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 SearchParameter with `expression` and no `processingMode` passes R4 but violates an R6 error invariant.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 SearchParameter with a separator or whitespace in `code` can become invalid in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: a previously valid SearchParameter can fail R6 validation if it lists comparators on an unsupported `type`.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
